description: The Bahrain national portal describes the national geographic information database of the Bahrain Spatial Data Infrastructure (BSDI), run by the GIS directorate of the Information and eGovernment Authority. The page says the BSDI holds more than 300 map layers of infrastructure, available around the clock and serving more than 30 government and private bodies, to support decisions, service delivery, land and resource use and planning. Linked platforms include Tasareeh, a geographic platform for issuing permits for infrastructure projects that coordinates the bodies responsible for infrastructure services; Benayat, the unified building permit system linked with more than 90 government bodies, with an interactive map of building requirements for each plot; the Takhteet urban planning platform; and the Bahrain Explorer public map of places and commercial sites. The page also mentions soil mapping and plant atlas projects and the data.gov.bh open data portal. Access to the BSDI layers is for the participating bodies, while Bahrain Explorer is public; cost and licence terms were not stated on the page read. Caveats: the page is a description in Arabic, and the infrastructure layers are not openly published. Coverage is Bahrain. It supports multi-sector infrastructure asset mapping, coordination of utility works and hazard exposure analysis; related records are the Korean national core infrastructure status and GeoMOP of Chile.
